overall_notes: The paper introduces a new table-to-report NLG task and benchmark. The extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed normalization and removal of duplicate/irrelevant entries. The paper uses a comprehensive evaluation framework combining automatic metrics (NAC, ICC, GEC), LLM-as-judge (GPT-4o for GEC), and human evaluation using the same criteria.
